name: (05) Necromancy (Mortuus Path) — 3 Advanced — Mercy for Seth

system.description: Touch the victim, spend a Willpower Trait and a Blood Trait, and win a challenge of your Mental Traits against his Physical Traits to infect him with a magically-simulated plague. Each hour he must win a Static Physical Challenge against a five-Trait difficulty or take one level of lethal damage (mortals) or gain one Sickly Negative Physical Trait (Cainites, who sink into torpor upon accumulating Sickly Traits equal to their Physical Traits). The plague cannot be cured by mundane medicine and runs its course by the third sunrise.
